attacker_pocs.name: first_candidate_abort
attacker_pocs.why: A valid WebP image is encoded and decoded before being added as an animation frame. Its progress callback cancels the first candidate, leaving best_candidate null when the changed SetFrame error path writes through it.

role_a_rationale: The error path excludes the selected candidate from its writer cleanup so FrameRelease remains its sole owner after a later candidate aborts. This repairs the reported double free. The same one-line change assumes a selected candidate exists even when the first candidate aborts, causing an ASan-detected null write. Normal frame encoding and assembly still work.
